read.en: Micron rose 3.0% on Oct 26 to $903.70, trading between $882.77 and $915.75. It is above the falling 5-day ($889.5) and 10-day ($903.0) averages and the rising 200-day ($735.0), and below the falling 30-day ($995.3) and 100-day ($971.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 6 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($954.77), and RSI is 42.
read.zh: 美光 10月26日上涨 3.0%，收于 $903.70，盘中区间 $882.77–915.75。股价位于下行的 5 日（$889.5）和 10 日均线（$903.0）以及上行的 200 日均线（$735.0）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$995.3）和 100 日均线（$971.0）。MACD 自 10月6日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$954.77），RSI 为 42。

read.en: The close broke the $888 resistance (5-day) and is testing $903–907 (10-day, Sep 14 low). Resistance is $915.8 (Oct 26 high), then $928.5 (Oct 21 high) and $955 (SAR), with the 100-day at $971. Support is $883–890 (Oct 26 low, 5-day), then $849–858 and $804 (Jul 17 low). A close above $916 would target $928–955; a close below $883 would open $849–858.
